_comment: Example: faithful configuration port for braindance_proj

predictor/nrp/: Neural activity foundation models: cached datasets/dataloaders → model definitions (Mamba, transformer) → NRP training jobs → checkpoints and diagnostics.
predictor/analysis/: Evaluate trained predictors: checkpoints + recordings → fine-tuning, perturbation, transfer and behavior analyses → metrics tables.
predictor/figures/: Predictor paper figures: derived metrics/embeddings → per-panel plotting scripts → figure files.
predictor/paper2_ood/: Out-of-distribution generalization study for the predictor models.
predictor_v3/utils/catalog/: Curated CSVs + NWB headers → versioned catalog → RecordingSet (organoid_id is the leakage unit).
predictor_v3/utils/data/: Sorted NWB → RecordingData (BrainDance) → binned counts + artifact-aligned stim → BLKZ2 shards + MANIFEST.csv.
predictor_v3/utils/model/: models.yaml registry → strict checkpoint load → InferenceSpec → engine.run → latents; extract jobs write the latent cache.
predictor_v3/utils/infer/: models.yaml registry → strict checkpoint load → InferenceSpec → engine.run → latents; extract jobs write the latent cache.
predictor_v3/utils/train/: TrainConfig presets → shard manifest dataloader → MambaConvPredictor training with resume → checkpoints.
predictor_v3/utils/jobs/: Predictor v3: NRP Jobs and Images
`python -m predictor_v3.cli job` (dry-run default) → sized Job YAML on the pinned image → entry.run_job; Kaniko builds the base/overlay images.
predictor_v3/utils/docker/: Predictor v3: NRP Jobs and Images
`python -m predictor_v3.cli job` (dry-run default) → sized Job YAML on the pinned image → entry.run_job; Kaniko builds the base/overlay images.
predictor_v3/utils/toolkit/: Load models, submit latent jobs, pull cached latents (sidecar-verified) for fast analyses.
predictor_v3/analyses/: Load models, submit latent jobs, pull cached latents (sidecar-verified) for fast analyses.
predictor_v3/: predictor_v3 CLI, settings and gates; see docs/GETTING_STARTED.md.
rt_sort_3d/: Learned spike-embedding sorter replacing RT-Sort's sequence stage: detections → embeddings → unit assignment.
busy_bee/: Busy Bee closed-loop experiment code, including NRP RT-Sort jobs.
ml_learning/fly/: Organoid-drives-fly odor taxis: FlyOdorEnv (FlyGym 2.x, 200 ms read windows, L/R odor in → L/R descending drive out) → policies/episodes → EpisodeLog → offline cinematic render or LiveFeed → real-time viewer. Next: rig phase (see ml_learning/fly/HANDOFF.md).
ml_learning/ant/: Organoid drives a MuJoCo Ant through a frozen 3-D PCA of its activity (baseline + causal sweep): vx/vy/heading offset rate code in, linear REINFORCE/PPO policy out, episode summaries for a tetanus controller; built on the fly rig loop (fr_loop setup_rig/PulseStream); live/replay viewer, log replay check.
ml_learning/: Machine-learning readouts and training for cartpole and related tasks.
braindance_figs/: BrainDance paper figures: derive_data scripts → figure panels → assembled figures.

library_note: BrainDance library — see `.code-summaries/` in the BrainDance repository
